text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You are wonderful, Mejiro Bright. Truly...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, thank you very much~.
I'm delighted to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, so...
what exactly is so wonderful about it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi from Monthly Twinkle burst into the room
and immediately showered us with praise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I have no idea
what I'm being praised for..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright-san.
I was looking into your race records, and—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You've put up quite an impressive record in long distances, haven't you? With 2 or more wins in races of 2,500m or longer.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright to arrange an interview as a special feature?
With that stayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Yes~ of course~.
If that's what this is about, gladly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a special discussion was arranged.
The partner for it was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Lady Rice~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(It is truly an honor.
To think I am able to converse with Lady Rice Shower,
who has even triumphed over Lady McQueen.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Still, something feels... scary?
Like someone's glaring at me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Could it be... that you feel you must defeat me as well...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice isn't really used to interviews like this...
So Rice is... n-nervous...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Bright-san.
Um, but I always watch your races...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I think it's truly amazing.
So... um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Rice~. You actually
knew who I was~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, the pleasure is mine.
I watch your races almost every day, Rice-sama~

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Every day...? S-So that's how it was...
Thank you... Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to learn all sorts of things from you,
so, um~ if you wouldn't mind~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to become
good friends with me~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Besties...!
Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If Rice is okay, then yes, please.
Good friends... Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the tension gone, the conversation flows smoothly.
Through this discussion, Mejiro Bright seems to have learned even more tips for long-distance racing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You've put up a considerable record in long distances, haven't you? With 4 or more wins in races of 2,500m or longer.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright to arrange an interview as a special feature?
With that stayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Yes~ of course~.
If that's what this is about, gladly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a special discussion was arranged.
The partner for it was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady McQueen...
So you were my dialogue partner all along~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is deeply moving.
To be facing you like this in a public setting, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still... how should I put it...
It feels a little ticklish, doesn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... That tickles...
What does this mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I had to make a comparison... it's like reuniting
with a former junior after growing up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel there is no longer any need for polite speech between us.
Like calling each other Bright and Mac-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa... Mac-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-Well, never mind that! More importantly, let us do this properly today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Tell me your philosophy as a stayer.
What is it that you hold most dear when you run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You now stand as my equal.
For we are the twin pillars of the long-distance Mejiros."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, Lady McQueen.
It is truly an honor~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Bright took part in the talk show with dignity, standing as Mejiro McQueen's equal.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You've put up an unbelievable record in long distances, haven't you? Over 6 wins in races of 2,500m or longer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright to arrange an interview as a special feature?
With that person!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Yes~ of course~.
If that's what this is about, gladly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a special discussion was arranged.
The partner for it was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Bright, you have done well to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: G-Grandmother...? Then don't tell me, the person for today's interview is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Yes, there was talk of McQueen doing it, but I decided to take it on myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
The only one who can converse with you as you are now
is me, who knows the entire history of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro mission: "To produce historic stayers."
I could have chosen to give up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we simply could not give up
on the dream we deemed so noble—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Now that it has borne fruit like this,
I am sure everyone is overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are those who have dreamed.
Many people whom you do not know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Something I never knew...
Is that so, Grandmother...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I pay my respects
to the long and storied history of the Mejiros...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even among those I have never met,
there were so many who placed their dreams in me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even so, this is a commemorative dialogue.
I don't intend to talk only about stiff, serious topics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Let's speak frankly, Bright.
I'll speak my mind freely as well.
Just like in our younger days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Grandmother...!
Yes~, I am looking forward to it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason why Lady Mejiro showed her true feelings was because Mejiro Bright has grown into such a magnificent stayer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through this interview,
Mejiro Bright gained immense confidence and awareness.
